title: Ilaalada Beerta
intro: Beer qurux badan, bulsho ayaa ku dhaaratay nidar adag. Laakiin go'aankooda waxaa la tijaabiyay markii rabitaanka rabbaaniga ah uu soo farageliyay, taasoo deeqdooda u beddeshay dhul cidla ah.
clues: Beero badan ayaa naloogu deeqay, laakiin waan isla weynay.
Waxaan samaynay qorshe aan wax ku goosanno annagoo aan la wadaagin dadka saboolka ah.
Waagii hore ayaan baxnay aroortii, annagoo ku kalsoon qorshahayaga.
Laakiin markii aan nimid, waxaan ogaanay in beertayadii ay habeenimo burburtay.
Khaladkeennii waan garowsannay, waxaana bilownay inaan is eedayno.
Ugu dambeyntii waan toobad keennay, laakiin casharkii waa la bartay goor dambe.

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Way toobad keeneen laakiin beertoodii way waayeen
outcome.answer: Way toobad keeneen laakiin beertoodii way waayeen

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
